title: provider.read_page takes a title's or heading's suffix as the publisher, so kbid.py add writes 'Windows' for '# Install - Windows'
goal: provider.read_page takes the organisation only from the host's providers.csv organisation cell or the page's own site name (og:site_name, application-name), never from the part of a <title> or Markdown heading after a dash or bar, and keeps the whole title

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import provider as p;p.request=lambda u,**k:{'status':200,'error':'','body':b'# Install - Windows\n','headers':{'content-type':'text/plain'}};r=p.read_page('https://example.com/a.md',p.providers(None));print(r);sys.exit(1 if r['organisation']=='Windows' or r['title']!='Install - Windows' else 0)
